data.exact_reserve_text: Prior year development is calculated from the 'Claims development table gross of reinsurance' on page 11 by comparing the current estimate for each underwriting year (prior to 2019) with its estimate from the previous development period (as of 2018).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant favorable prior year development (release) of $144.8 million, primarily driven by a release on the 2017 underwriting year. This was calculated from the gross claims development table, indicating an overall improvement in the ultimate claims estimates for prior periods. No specific events or detailed causal factors were explicitly quantified for this movement, but it reflects a recalibration of IBNR estimates.
raw_causal_phrases: uncertainty associated with the ultimate claims experience
The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development table by comparing the latest estimate for each underwriting year (prior to 2019) with its estimate from the previous development period (as of 2018). The 'Movement in provision' in the Technical Provisions note includes both current and prior year movements and was not used for PYD.
